body.p: Claims 1-11 are allowed. Prosecution on the merits is closed in accordance with the practice under Ex parte Quayle, 1935 C.D. 11, 453 O.G. 213.

Claims 1 and 2 are objected to because of the alleged informalities. Applicant respectfully disagrees. However, for compact prosecution, the claims have been amended to remove all the alleged informalities, as suggested by the Examiner.
Claims 1-11 are also further amended in a minor manner to place the claims in better form for allowance. Withdrawal of the objections to the claims is therefore respectfully requested.
Also, the Examiner asserts that the "vision check part," "nut fastening part," and "fastening check part" of claim 1 invoke interpretation under 35 U.S.C. 112(f).

Without conceding the appropriateness of the Examiner's assertion, Applicant has amended the "vision check part," "nut fastening part," and "fastening check part" to "vision sensor," "nut fastener... having a predetermined insertion depth," and "fastening check controller," respectively.

Support for the "vision sensor" may be found in page 6, lines 9-15, of the specification as filed. Support for the "nut fastener... having a predetermined insertion depth" may be found in page 8, lines 6-11, and FIGS. 4-7 of the specification as filed. Support for the "fastening check controller" may be found in page 6, lines 20-26, of the specification as filed.
Withdrawal of the claim interpretation under 35 USC 112(f) is therefore respectfully requested.
